summary: Iteration 5 - Validated mobile responsiveness, plans removal from user dashboard, deposit presets end-to-end, Super Admin notification campaigns, team announcements, push subscription endpoints, and Meta Pixel admin flows. Backend: 28/28 tests pass. Frontend: all tested routes (/, /login, /register, /legal/risk, /rewards/international-trip, /app, /app/deposit, /app/withdraw, /app/wallet, /app/team, /app/rewards, /app/notifications, /app/announcements, /app/support, /app/profile, /app/webinar, /app/guides, /admin, /admin/users, /admin/deposits, /admin/campaigns, /admin/pixels, /admin/learn, /admin/payment-methods) have scrollWidth == clientWidth at 390x844 (no horizontal scroll). Hamburger menu present on dashboard (data-testid=mobile-nav-toggle). Plans removal verified: USER_NAV in App.js has no 'Participation plans' entry, Overview stats are {Team members, Current rank, Unread notifications, USDT balance} (no coin/plan stat cards), QUICK array has no plans quick action (quick-plans selector absent), /app/plans redirects to /app/deposit. Deposit presets: deposit-preset-100 element rendered; backend POST /api/deposits with method_id creates draft with expected_display. Admin approve_manual on draft credits user wallet exactly once; repeat approve returns 400. Withdrawal with valid TRON address reserves and reject releases. Campaigns: create with audience=selected|all delivers to notification_recipients inbox+popup, disable campaign hides popup via /notifications/popups, scheduled_at future stays 'scheduled', audience validation rejects selected without user_ids. Team announcements: Bronze (demo.a) can send to downline (team scope), Member rank (demo.f, no downline) gets 403, downline (demo.b) receives via notifications/report path, admin can hide. Push endpoints: /push/subscribe stores well-formed subscription, /push/permission accepts granted|denied|default|unsupported|later and 422 on invalid, /push/public-key returns {publicKey}. Pixels: create requires name+pixel_id regex ^\d{10,20}$, update active=false removes from GET /public/pixels response.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_user.create_deposit uses method_id (correct) but DepositIn has no idem_key field so repeated client POSTs within rate-limit window create multiple drafts (count limit of 3 drafts protects somewhat). Consider adding idem_key like withdrawals.
routes_admin.disable_campaign swallows failures silently - returns ok:True even if campaign_id does not exist (update_one with no match). Minor; consider 404 when campaign not found.

routes_user.send_team_message: when b.scope == 'individual' and recipient_ids has 2+ IDs, code slices to [:1] AFTER filtering by downline, so an attacker-selected list of 10 downline IDs is silently truncated to 1. Fine, but could 400 for clarity.
routes_user.report_message checks n.get('team_message_id') but find_one filter already requires kind='team' - redundant but safe.
App.js USER_NAV has 'Welcome webinar' and 'Video guides' entries - these are useful but appear below Profile; could be grouped under a 'Learn' section for UX. Non-blocking.

UserPages.jsx Overview subtitle still says 'Your USDT wallet, plans and team at a glance.' - word 'plans' leftover now that participation plans are removed. Suggest changing to 'Your USDT wallet and team at a glance.'
chain-based deposits: create_deposit returns 400 'Payment method unavailable' when method inactive, but if valid address placeholder saved verbatim it returns 'not configured yet' - good UX.
No DELETE endpoint for /admin/campaigns - disabled campaigns stay in list forever. Minor housekeeping.

routes_admin.deposit_action approve_manual on 'failed' deposit will credit again if credited_amount set - double-check logic in post_ledger idempotency: idem_key=f'dep:{did}' prevents double-credit even if approve_manual is called repeatedly on same id (verified in test_double_approve_fails -> 400 because status is now verified).

Push /push/unsubscribe only toggles active=False on matching endpoint - does not update user.push_permission; if user's only subscription is deactivated, push_permission still shows 'granted'. Low priority.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (mobile scroll on 24 routes, plans removal, deposit presets, admin pages)

seed_data_creation: During test run: TRC20 payment-method address was set to TR7NHqjeKQxGTCi8q8ZY4pL8otSzgjLj6t and restored to '[Set your TRC20 receiving address]' at teardown. BEP20 confirmed at placeholder. 1 TEST pixel (123456789012345), 2 TEST campaigns (TEST_Campaign_notif, TEST_Scheduled), 1 TEST team announcement (TEST_TeamAnnounce), 1 TEST deposit per cycle - all deleted post-run (payment_submissions with status_note containing TEST removed, 4 docs cleaned). LEDGER IS IMMUTABLE: demo.b has 2 approved deposit ledger rows (+10,000 cents each = $200 total credited; memo 'USDT deposit approved by admin') that could not be removed. Verified wallet row shows the accumulated balance. This is from iteration 5 approval tests - acceptable because demo.b is a seed user and the funds stay in the test environment; a production run would use a TEST_ prefixed user. Recommend next iteration use a dedicated TEST_ user (register via API with TEST_ email) so ledger entries can be deleted along with the user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test: /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_notifications.py (28 tests). Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://sim-finance-hub.preview.emergentagent.com MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database pytest backend/tests/test_iter5_notifications.py -v -n 0. Previous iters: test_iter3_chain.py (16), test_iter4_learn.py (24), backend_test.py. The /admin/pixels response is {items:[...], events:[...]} not a bare list - handle accordingly. Wallet endpoint is /api/wallet (singular) and returns {wallets:{...}, ledger:{...}}. Deposit amount is in dollars (float), withdrawal amount min=100 dollars. Mobile scroll check: await page.evaluate('() => ({sw: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, cw: document.documentElement.clientWidth})') - all routes tested at 390x844 have sw===cw. demo.b wallet carries over ~$200 from approved test deposits (immutable ledger). If retesting withdraw release, use min_amount=100 dollars.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs blocking functionality. One minor copy issue noted: Overview subtitle says 'wallet, plans and team' - should drop 'plans'. Report action items section lists all code review suggestions.
